info.title: CommonBeacon REST API
info.description: Implemented /api/v1 contract. Same-origin cookie sessions, CSRF on every mutation. Roles include MEMBER, MODERATOR, ADMINISTRATOR. Ordinary conversation writes reject archived boards; reporting/moderation remain available. Text is plain text, trimmed as documented and bounded in UTF-16 units (JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points). All page offsets must fit a signed 32-bit integer. Business failures use ProblemDetail; infrastructure failures can have other response shapes. Health probes /api/health and /healthz are deployment endpoints, outside this contract.

get.description: English weighted title/body full-text search. Visible questions (including archived boards) and published articles only. Blank/tokenless query returns zero hits. One value each for q/page/size, unknown/repeated keys rejected. Order rank DESC, ARTICLE before QUESTION, UUID ASC. Counts/items share a snapshot; page*size <= 2147483647. Snippets are body prefixes; no reply search or typo correction.

post.description: Confirm the current password. Single-use grant expires after five minutes and is bound to actor, authorization revision, session and scope. Company/import scopes require ADMINISTRATOR. Limit: five attempts per actor and twenty per socket address per fifteen minutes. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Current database permissions and requester ownership are required.

post.description: Requires an ACTIVE ADMINISTRATOR, CSRF, a UUID Idempotency-Key, acknowledgedPrivateContent=true and a COMPANY_EXPORT recent-authentication grant. Contacts and moderation history default false independently (omitted/null means false). All company archives include hidden content and unpublished articles. Matching logical retries return the original job without consuming another grant; changed options conflict. Storage must be enabled. Poll the requester-owned company job and use a fresh DOWNLOAD grant/ticket when READY. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store.
